title: Yellow Creamy Chinese Pasta Noodles
description: A buttery, creamy Chinese-inspired pasta dish that is easy to make and kid-friendly. This recipe is ovo-vegetarian and features a unique cider vinegar taste.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to package instructions.
In a small saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the all-purpose flour and whisk together to make a smooth paste.
Slowly pour in the heavy cream, whisking constantly to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until it thickens.
Remove the sauce from the heat and stir in the chicken broth, soy sauce, and cider vinegar.
Drain the cooked pasta and return it to the pot.
Add the sauce to the pasta and toss everything together until the pasta is well coated.
Stir in the chopped green onions and grated ginger.
Serve the noodles hot and enjoy!
If desired, add eggs to the sauce to create a creamy, eggy sauce.
Let the sauce simmer for a few more minutes to allow the flavors to meld together.
